Dune: Awakening
Announcement
Dune: Awakening - 1.4.10.5 Hotfix Patch Notes

Hey Sleepers.

This hotfix requires a client-side download. Remember to restart your Steam client if the download does not appear automatically for you. Servers will be coming back up shortly.

For the list of known issues, please visit our Discord server[discord.gg] or Steam discussion boards.

Fixes

  • Fixed a major portion of the issues causing the Static Compactor to sometimes fail to unearth objects during the Convergence and Sample Recovery Landsraad missions.

  • Fixed an issue where some players on the Harmony World had a Sub-Fief Console on the closed Deep Desert server, causing the Sub-Fief to count toward their total land-claim limit. We also cleared all vehicles that remained on the closed DD servers across all worlds.
